d: Our client, an ambitious and growing law firm in Oman offering a broad range of legal services to corporate and individual clients, is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Sole Accountant & Billing Officer to manage the firm's accounting functions and legal billing operations.
The ideal candidate will be involved with preparing financial reports and statements, bank reconciliations, and conducting cyclical audits.
Maintain accurate accounting records and financial transactions
Monitor and reconcile bank accounts, cash accounts, and other balance sheet accounts
Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
Perform bank reconciliations and monitor cash flow
Ensure compliance with Omani tax, VAT, and financial regulations
Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning
Coordinate with external auditors and regulatory authorities
Process payroll and employee expense reimbursements
Maintain payroll records and statutory deductions
Support finance-related administrative tasks as required
Prepare and issue client invoices based on lawyers' timesheets, fixed-fee arrangements,
Follow up on outstanding payments and maintain aging reports
Reconcile client accounts and billing records
Coordinate with lawyers and partners regarding billing matters and fee collections
Generate billing and revenue reports for management review
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
Professional certifications such as ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent are an advantage
Minimum 6-8 years+ of experience in accounting, billing, or finance administration
Experience in a law firm, consulting firm, or professional services environment is preferred
Strong understanding of accounting principles, invoicing, and receivables management
Knowledge of VAT regulations and financial reporting requirements in Oman
Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel
Excellent numerical, analytical, and organizational skills
Fluency in English; preferably native Arabic speaker

Founded in Geneva in 2015, Drive Luxury provides premium chauffeur services in more than 100 countries for luxury travel agencies, family offices, global corporates and event organisers. We have a direct presence in Switzerland, France, Italy, Austria, the UK and Bahrain, and a network of trusted partners worldwide. Our promise: one contact, real people available 24/7, and the same standard of service wherever our clients travel.
We are building our international business development team, and we are looking for a Business Development Manager for the GCC, based in Bahrain.
Open and grow accounts across the GCC: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman
Target family offices and private offices, luxury travel agencies and concierges, and the travel and events teams of large groups
Sell Drive Luxury's global chauffeur services to GCC clients, with a strong focus on Europe, our main hub: Switzerland, France, the UK, Italy and Austria, especially during the summer season
Run the full sales cycle: prospecting, meetings, proposals, closing and account growth
Represent Drive Luxury at regional trade shows and industry events
Keep a clean, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM (Odoo) and report weekly
5+ years in B2B sales in luxury travel, hospitality, DMC, private aviation or VIP transport in the GCC
An established network with family offices, private offices, luxury agencies or corporate travel teams
A hunter mindset: comfortable with outreach, follow-up and closing
Fluent English; Arabic is a strong advantage
Able to travel regularly across the GCC
Organised, autonomous and disciplined with a CRM
A competitive fixed salary plus an attractive commission plan on the business you bring
A premium product with global reach to sell from day one
Direct access to the founder and real autonomy to build the GCC market
A growing international team in Geneva, Paris, Bahrain and beyond
Apply via LinkedIn with your CV and a short note on the client network you would bring.
